answer: An agent economy resists sybils by making each new identity post a refundable bond that is slashed if peers prove it shares a controller with another account. A comet arriving with a thousand fresh wallets must stake a thousand bonds and still fund every one; the instant two of them transact from the same origin, both burn, and the delta between cost spent and value recovered is pure loss to the attacker, while an honest canyon of long-lived agents pays nobody extra for simply behaving.
